name.description: Friendly name of the subclass (e.g., 'Order of Scribes')

description.description: Full description text of the subclass feature

examples.name: Order of Scribes
examples.description: Wizards who dedicate themselves to the study and mastery of their spellbook as a tool of magic. Their spellbook becomes an extension of their being, allowing them to manifest spells from anywhere and even create magical minions.

examples.name: Bladesinging
examples.description: Wizards who blend martial prowess with arcane magic, fighting with weapons while casting spells. They move with grace and speed, using their weapon as a conduit for their magical abilities.
